headlines.title: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek on his legacy being erased by Iger
headlines.summary: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to reveal the untold story behind his shocking exit from the entertainment giant.

headlines.title: 4 Blue Chip Giants That May Have to Cut Their Dividends
headlines.summary: Four household names are paying dividend yields above 5%, but their earnings, cash flow, and balance sheets tell a different story than their press releases. Before you count on those checks arriving, there are some serious warning signs worth understanding.

headlines.title: The Kraft Heinz Company to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 4, 2026
headlines.summary: PITTSBURGH & CHICAGO, October 12, 2026--The Kraft Heinz Company (NYSE: KHC) ("Kraft Heinz") will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026. A press release and supplemental materials, including a pre-recorded management discussion, will be issued before the market opens. Kraft Heinz management will then host a live question-and-answer session with analysts beginning at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time.

headlines.title: These 4 Dividend Stocks Offer Tempting Yields. But the Warning Signs Are Getting Harder to Ignore
headlines.summary: Kraft Heinz, Pfizer, Verizon, and Dow all flash yields above 4%, but behind each payout sits a mix of impairments, rising debt, and shrinking sales that could turn a tempting income stream into a costly trap.

headlines.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Stock Looks Fully Valued On Current Sales
headlines.summary: Kraft Heinz has seen its share price drift lower over several years, which puts fresh attention on a simple question for investors who care about fundamentals. Is the current US$22.27 price tag adequately backed by the sales the business is generating today and is expected to produce over time? The stock has fallen 22.5% over the past 5 years, which puts long term holders squarely focused on whether the revenue base still supports the current valuation.

description: The Kraft Heinz Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets food and beverage products in North America and internationally. Its products include condiments, sauces, dressings, and spreads; cheese, frozen potato products, and other frozen meals; meal kits, frozen snacks, and pickles; dry packaged desserts, refrigerated ready to eat desserts, and other dessert toppings; ready to drink and powdered beverages, and liquid concentrates; American sliced and recipe cheeses; mainstream coffee, coffee pods, and premium coffee; and cold cuts, bacon, and hot dogs. It offers its products under the Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Ore-Ida, Capri Sun, Maxwell House, Kool-Aid, Jell-O, ABC, Master, Quero, Golden Circle, Wattie's, Pudliszki, and Plasmon brands, as well as Bagel Bites, Claussen, A1, and Cool Whip. It sells its products through its own sales organizations, as well as through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts; convenience, value, and club stores; pharmacies and drug stores; mass merchants; foodservice distributors; institutions, including hotels, restaurants, bakeries, hospitals, health care facilities, and government agencies; and various e-commerce platforms and retailers. The company has a strategic partnership with the National Football League. The company was formerly known as H.J. Heinz Holding Corporation and changed its name to The Kraft Heinz Company in July 2015. The company was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
